data.name: Ivaz
data.gender_notes: Ivaz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Ibrah', meaning 'strong' and 'powerful'. This name signifies strength in adversity and the courage to overcome challenges. The name Ivaz carries the meaning “Strength, Power” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ivaz usually hope their child will grow to embody strength, power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name resonates with the spiritual power of Allah and inspires one to seek strength and guidance from Him in times of need.
data.etymology: Ivaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strength, Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ivaz total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: إيفاز
in_arabic.meaning: إيفاز يعني العطاء أو الهبة من الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: إيفاز هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع-و-ز' والذي يحمل معاني العطاء والهبة. في اللغة العربية، يرتبط هذا الاسم بفكرة منح الله تعالى للإنسان نعمًا وفضلًا. إيفاز هو اسم يوحي بالشكر والامتنان لله على عطاياه.

in_urdu.name: ایفاز
in_urdu.meaning: ایفاز مطلب ہے اللہ کی ہبہ یا عطا
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایفاز ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ع-و-ز' کے جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے عطا کرنا یا ہبہ کرنا۔ یہ نام اللہ تعالیٰ کی طرف سے انسان کو دی جانے والی نعمتوں اور احسانات کی یاد دلاتا ہے۔ ایفاز نام کا انتخاب کرنے والے والدین اپنے بچے کے لیے اللہ کی محبت اور عطا کی معانی جمع کرنا چاہتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: इफाज
in_hindi.meaning: इफाज का अर्थ है भगवान की ओर से उपहार
in_hindi.long_meaning: इफाज नाम अरबी भाषा के 'ع-و-ز' मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'देना' या 'उपहार'। यह नाम मुस्लिम समुदाय में भगवान की कृपा और आशीर्वाद की भावना को दर्शाता है। इफाज नाम रखने वाले माता-पिता अपने बच्चे के लिए अल्लाह की दया और उदारता के अर्थ एकत्र करना चाहते हैं।

in_pashto.name: ایفاز
in_pashto.meaning: ایفاز د الله تعالی د ډالۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایفاز نوم د عربي ژبې د 'ع-و-ز' ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې ده ډالۍ یا انعام. دا نوم د الله تعالی د نعمتونو او احساناتو یادونه کوي. هغه والدین چې ایفاز نوم غوره کوي، د خپل ماشوم لپاره د الله د مینې او ډالۍ معنی غواړي.

in_english.name: Ivaz
in_english.meaning: Ivaz means a gift or blessing from Allah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ivaz is derived from the Arabic root 'ع-و-ز' (ʿ-w-z), which conveys the meanings of 'to give' or 'gift'. In Islamic tradition, Ivaz signifies a favor or blessing bestowed by Allah. The name reflects the concept of gratitude and acknowledgment of divine generosity. Historically, names with such roots have been used across various Muslim cultures to express spiritual values and the aspiration for a life guided by faith and righteousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ivaz holds deep cultural significance in the Islamic world, as it is derived from the name of the revered Prophet Ibrahim in the Islamic tradition. The name evokes a sense of strength and resilience, reminding individuals of the challenges faced by Prophet Ibrahim in his journey of faith and the ultimate reward he received for his unwavering commitment to God.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ivaz also holds great spiritual significance, as it serves as a constant reminder of the power and strength that comes from having faith in God. Ivaz encourages individuals to draw upon their inner reserves of strength and courage, even in the face of adversity, knowing that they are not alone in their struggles and that ultimately, their faith and trust in God will help them overcome any challenge. Additionally, the name Ivaz serves as a reminder of the importance of being a strong and resilient spiritual force in one's community, demonstrating the qualities of courage, perseverance, and unwavering commitment to one's faith.
